{{color2|000|Pokémon Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl|Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Lucian/Quotes}} ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== [[File:Lucian anime.png|thumb|250px|Lucian in {{aniseries|DP}}]] ====''Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl''==== Lucian debuted in ''[[DP035|An Elite Meet and Greet!]]''. He was first seen battling with his {{p|Girafarig}} on [[television]]. Then, he met {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} in a [[Pokémon Center]]. He informed them about the {{DL|Pokémon League|Champion League}} and later had a {{pkmn|battle}} against {{an|Dawn}} and her {{TP|Dawn|Buizel}} using his {{p|Bronzong}}. Buizel's attacks didn't have much of an effect, if any, on Bronzong. Following {{m|Gyro Ball}}, Bronzong used {{m|Flash Cannon}} to defeat its opponent. Lucian later had a [[rematch]] against Dawn and Buizel, though he ended the battle prematurely because he saw that the pair had improved, but still needed some work. He made a brief cameo appearance on television in ''[[DP040|Top-Down Training!]]''. He battled {{an|Cynthia}} for her title of [[Pokémon Champion]] of the [[Sinnoh League]], but was defeated. ====[[Pokémon movie]]s==== He also made a brief cameo appearance in the ending credits of ''[[M13|Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]''. ====Character==== Lucian is polite and likes to help out a {{pkmn|Trainer}}. He builds up his defenses and tends to evade an opponent's attacks in an attempt to learn their strategy and exhaust them before striking back. ====Pokémon==== This listing is of Lucian's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: =====On hand===== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Lucian |pkmn=Bronzong |type1=Steel |type2=Psychic |img=Lucian Bronzong.png |epnum=DP035 |epname=An Elite Meet and Greet! |vajp=Unshō Ishizuka |vaen=Carter Cathcart{{!}}Billy Beach |desc={{p|Bronzong}} is Lucian's main Pokémon. The first time he used it was in ''[[DP035|An Elite Meet and Greet!]]'', where it {{pkmn|battle}}d {{an|Dawn}}'s newly captured {{TP|Dawn|Buizel}}. Because Buizel didn't listen to Dawn, he quickly lost. Later in the same episode, they had a [[rematch]], and because Buizel was now listening to Dawn, the battle went better. However, Lucian eventually recalled Bronzong, saying that he had just wanted to prove Buizel's potential for becoming strong. Lucian's match against [[Cynthia's Garchomp]] was televised in ''[[DP040|Top-Down Training!]]'', but the Bronze Bell Pokémon was soon [[fainting|knocked out]] by the Mach Pokémon's powerful {{m|Giga Impact}}. Bronzong also appeared alongside Lucian during the credits of ''[[M13|Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]''. Bronzong's known moves are {{m|Iron Defense}}, {{m|Gyro Ball}}, and {{m|Flash Cannon}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Lucian |pkmn=Girafarig |type1=Normal |type2=Psychic |img=Lucian Girafarig.png |epnum=DP035 |epname=An Elite Meet and Greet! |desc=Lucian was seen using his {{p|Girafarig}} on television in a battle against a {{pkmn|Trainer}}'s {{p|Scizor}}. It was easily able to dodge all of Scizor's {{m|Slash}} attacks and finally knock it out with a single strike, despite the [[type]] disadvantage. Girafarig's only known move is {{m|Psybeam}}.}} =====Temporary===== {{TrainerPoké |main=yes |trainer=Dawn |pkmn=Buizel |gender=male |type1=Water |img=Lucian Buizel.png |epnum=DP034 |epname=Buizel Your Way Out Of This! |vajp=Kiyotaka Furushima |vaen=Kiyotaka Furushima |desc=When {{an|Dawn}}'s newly caught {{p|Buizel}} was being stolen away by {{TRT}}, Lucian used him to battle against the thieves, showing Dawn that she could also be able to command the [[Pokémon category|Sea Weasel Pokémon]] which had been disobeying her during her battle with Lucian. Under Lucian's command, Buizel quickly defeated [[Jessie's Dustox]] and [[James's Carnivine]].}} ====Voice actors==== {{vatable|color={{psychic color}}|bordercolor={{psychic color light}} |ja=浪川大輔 ''[[Daisuke Namikawa]]'' |en=[[List of English voice actors|David Lapkin]] |fi=Aku Laitinen |pl=Janusz Wituch |pt_br=Ricardo Sawaya |pt_eu=Pedro Cardoso |es_la=Eduardo Garza |es_eu=Alejandro García}} ===GOTCHA!=== Lucian briefly appeared in [[GOTCHA!]]. ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Lucian Adventures.png|thumb|200px|Lucian in Pokémon Adventures]] Lucian, along with Bertha and Aaron, appears during the {{MangaArc|Platinum}}, having been enlisted by the [[Pokémon Association]] to decipher [[Charon]]'s notebook that was stolen by {{adv|Diamond}}'s [[Kit]]. Using his talents in reading books, Lucian is able to easily figure out what the book says and gives it to Diamond and {{adv|Pearl}} so they can use it to stop Charon from capturing the [[Legendary Pokémon]] of Sinnoh. In this {{pkmn|manga}}, Lucian's reading skills are shown to be great enough for him to easily finish a book in only a few mere moments. ====Pokémon==== =====On hand===== {{anchor|Girafarig 2}}{{TrainerPoké |width=74 |trainer=Lucian |pkmn=Girafarig |type1=Normal |type2=Psychic |img=Lucian Girafarig Adventures.png |epnum=PS423 |epname=Tackling Togekiss |desc={{p|Girafarig}} is the only known Pokémon in Lucian's possession.
